description: Golden bars of alternating heights are joined by cross-beams as a barrier on the edges of the square platform.  In the center, cobblestone pavers spiral outward from a tall iron lampost with a timeless statue in front of it.  The platform seemingly drifts along in a endless, soundless darkness.  In the corner on a raised pedestal is a large dark sign.

description: Cobblestone pavers lead up to a ripple of light spanning the center of the room.  Within the light, a distorted road winds its way up to a swan-embossed gate with a robust Vornavian guard standing next to it.

description: Ripples of light distort the water of Darkstone Bay surrounding the South Wharf.  Several two-masted schooners are moored nearby.

description: Cobblestone pavers lead up to a ripple of light spanning the center of the room.  Within the light, you can see somewhere near upper trollfang and a sink hole.
title: [Distorted Campaign Tent]

description: The smell of fish and salty sea air pervades the small building.  Several wooden crates of varying sizes are stacked haphazardly along the back wall near a long counter.  A large barrel holds some of the shop's wares, as well as the robust stench of worms and other bait.  Behind the counter, various goods are stacked upon some long shelves.
title: [Schooner Docks, Bait Shop]
33290.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The road bends sharply around a small tree-covered hillock, pitching a gradual slope to accommodate the rise and fall of the landscape.  Thick underbrush along each side has been cut well back from the edges of the trail.  The sparse forest lining each side provides some lovely glimpses of the surrounding area, as travelers traverse through the woods.
title: [Vornavis, Small Forest]
33584.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rising up over the top of a hill, this vantage point creates a slight clearing, affording a peek over the treetops.  To the northeast, a shadowy stone tower sits off in the distance, its crenellated design evident.  Wagon ruts are dug deep into the trail, commemorating the many travelers who have, at one time or another, stopped here to rest and catch the view.
title: [Vornavis, Small Forest]
33585.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The edge of the forest meets this winding road, wandering around several small hillocks, and a fresh breeze rustles leaves while gently caressing the countryside.  A dark stone keep sits high atop a rocky outcropping at the end of the road.
title: [Vornavis, Winding Road]
33586.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The soft sounds of a thin rushing river only hint at the power that must have cut the deep chasm that surrounds the walled keep sitting at this fork in the road.  Spanning the gap over the roiling water is a wooden drawbridge, supported by thick chains connecting it to a massive twin-turreted watchtower.  The grey stone walls of the keep stand in mute defense against any enemy from without.
title: [Vornavis, Keep Bridgehead]
33587.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A foot trail travels alongside the gorge, surrounding an impressive keep standing on the far side of the river, its grey stone walls and brown thatched roofs faded from weather and time.
title: [Vornavis, River Trail]
33588.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Climbing a small rise, the trail ends in a tiny clearing, the sound of the river becoming slower as it widens.  Downstream, the water gradually splays outward, growing flat and sluggish, with the keep painting a picturesque sight standing tall alongside the reflective river.
title: [Vornavis, River Trail]
33589.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Winding back and forth to avoid outcroppings of wet and slippery rocks from the splashing of the river, a tiny path leads down to a small cozy beach situated along a bend in the river.  Surrounded by three logs, the cold remains of a fire lie in a rough pit, and an unrecognizable charred bone rests upon the grey ashes mingled with bits of black charcoal.
title: [Vornavis, Small Beach]
33590.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Two heavy linked iron chains slip through a series of pulleys and wrap around a huge windlass, all covered in a heavy layer of grease and grime.  A number of curious dark small holes pierce the ceiling of the entry area.  Past a closed and rusted out black iron portcullis is an open central courtyard, while an old oak drawbridge leads back out towards the merchant road.
title: [Turamzzyrian Academy, Keep]
33591.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Hugging the river's edge, a slender path dips in and out of the nearby shrubbery as it lazily leads in a roughly northerly direction up the river.  Large stones, smoothed by the passage of water, rise along the banks and create a small barrier from the rapidly moving current as it dramatically dips to the south.  Lichen, moss, and ferns are prevalent here, their thick roots making the banks firm and durable.
title: [Vornavis, Small Beach]
33592.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Pale white sands glitter in the golden light of the day, their ultra fine grade causing them to sparkle ever so slightly when the sun's rays fall upon them.  Shrubs and underbrush fall away from a craggy slope, which leads up and away from the river to the south.  Conifers and oaks spread outward from the area, their leafy expanses making it difficult to see very far.
title: [Vornavis, Sandy Dune]
33593.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Nearly as tall as the upper branches of the surrounding forest, the hill top provides an excellent view of the surrounding area.  To the south, the river tumbles by at a stately pace through the berry-laden underbrush, while to the east the trees pay homage to a grassy plain where a dilapidated stone castle basks in the sun.  Though steep, the slope provides access to a game trail that heads back into the Cairnfang Forest.
title: [Vornavis, Hill Top]
33594.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Tall and unshorn, yellow and green blades of grass rise from the fertile soil and bend beneath the sporadic breezes that sweep across the plains.  Violets and baby's breath rise amid the verdant blades to add a spot of color to the largely molten expanse, while dark shadows along the edge of the plain hint at trees in the distance.  Narrow and winding, a game trail leads through the grass towards a hill to the south and a shadowy castle to the north.
title: [Vornavis, Grassy Plain]
33595.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Tall as a halfling, the yellow and green blades of grass rise in a perimeter around this small clearing, which is comprised of moss and packed dirt.  A tangled thicket of chokeberry briars occupies the western edge and stands as guardian over a large rabbit hole.  Dipping in and out of the clearing, a narrow track slowly ambles away from the area.
title: [Vornavis, Grassy Plain]
33596.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Verdant and earthy, the area is filled with dark green blades of grass that rise as tall as the average halfling.  Feathery tops slip from their protective sheaths within each bladed tendril and spill large quantities of seeds upon the moss-covered ground.  Long shadows stretch across the area from the incredibly high walls of the hedges that rise to the east.
title: [Vornavis, Grassy Plain]
33597.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Overgrown and wild, the hedges that rise out of the ground to create an imposing wall seem oddly out of place in the middle of the plains.  Scraggly tendrils reach outward like the spectral hands of some long forgotten ancestor, while a wild profusion of green, orange, and yellow leaves dimples the expanse.  Nearly choked by the untamed mass of vegetation is a small iron gate, which provides entry to the grounds.
title: [Academy, Topiary Entrance]
33598.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Bisecting the overgrown topiary neatly in half, a jagged fracture lined with rough limestone blocks provides egress from the maze.  Thick strands of clinging ivy hug the various pieces and fairly choke the space with their broad leaves.  Small and large evergreens extend their feathery fingers across the area creating a shadowed environment that keeps the ambient light from completely penetrating.
title: [Academy, Topiary Maze]
33599.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The tall hedges have been pruned back to form a smooth pathway within the maze.  Encroaching ivy has been trimmed away, leaving scattered gaps along the high herbaceous walls. paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south
title: [Academy, Topiary Maze]
33600.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Bright white mistletoe berries peek out from atop the tall hedges they have invaded. Large, broken seashells, firmly imbedded into the smooth dirt path, crunch underfoot as visitors pass through.

33601.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The row of hedges suddenly widens, exposing a fragrant rosemary topiary in the middle of the pathway. 33602.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Wide and uneven, the entryway to the keep arches high above and is covered in a yellowish-white, chalky substance that exudes a foul stench.  The once firmly packed ground of the courtyard is now pockmarked with small and large holes where pieces of stone and gravel have broken free.  Directly north is the courtyard and keep tower, and an old oak drawbridge is visible past a closed and rusted out black iron portcullis.  An east-west passage traverses the wall that surrounds the Academy.
title: [Academy, Lower Bailey]
33629.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Displaying visible signs of disrepair, a lofty tower of mottled grey stone rises from the roof of the keep in the center of the open courtyard.  Breached only by a riverstone ashlar arch, the keep's tower rises far above the walls that enclose it and has far fewer missing stones in its safe.  The surrounding grounds are filled with tumbleweeds, broken tree limbs, and a variety of chipped stones, which all lie amid large tufts of greasy feathers.
title: [Academy, Lower Bailey]
33630.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Towering walls of fitted stone line this spacious hall, arcing inward near the top to form the vaulted ceiling above.  Shredded tapestries and faded wall-hangings of purple and gold hang in tattered streamers from the walls among long ribbons of dust-laden spider's webs.  Tables and chairs, splintered and unserviceable, are piled in a large heap near the arch, while a sideboard, still draped in old festival streams, leans precariously near a small passageway cut into the rear wall.
title: [Academy Keep, Great Hall]
33631.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Clogged with the rotted remains of books, parchments, and scrolls, the solid monir bookcases that enclose the once great library are stained with mold and swollen with fetid water.  Broken tables and chairs lie in shambles about the space and are draped in blankets fashioned of cobwebs and dust.  Resting in the clear space at the center of the room is a polished silver tray laden with the remains of some long ago offering.
title: [Keep Tower, Library]
33632.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Despite the warm golden glow of sunlight that streams in through the ashlar-framed bow window the sitting room is chilly and the air is rank with the smell of stagnant water.  Once plush chairs, now shredded and devoid of their stuffing, stand skeletal around the room in a semicircle.  Using the wall as a support, a three-legged oak sideboard draped with a moldy covering teeters under a load of rotting food.
title: [Keep Tower, Sitting Room]
33633.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Several warped wooden barrels lean against the rear wall of the keep, their sides broken and their rotting contents spilling upon the uneven cobblestones of the courtyard.  Dark watermarks stain the walls around passage that has been cut into the wall of the keep tower.  The skeletal remains of a canine lie in a heap of rotted hides not far from the small entry.
title: [Academy, Upper Bailey]
33634.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Weeping with moisture, the stone wall is heavy with moss and black mold due in part to the rotting remains of an old stone well sitting nearby.  The peaked wood roof of the structure has rotted away, and the dowel has broken from the crank, leaving no sign of the old rope and bucket.
title: [Academy, Northern Wall]
33635.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The corner here is dark and damp, with much of this section of wall cracked and splitting, and the arch slightly misshapen yet still standing tall.  The carefully cut stones of the peaked opening are a light green in color, and carved on each are intricate patterns of small trees and flowers.
title: [Academy, Northwest Corner]
33636.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Overgrown huckleberry bushes create a wild border around a small orchard of dead fruit trees.  Climbing strawberry vines cling to an arched opening and threaten to choke the space with their reaching tendrils.  Rotted berries, oranges, apples, and pears linger on the ground where they have fallen due to being left too long on the limb.  The scent of their soft bodies rotting upon the ground fills the air with oddly sweet, bitter perfume.
title: [Academy, Orchard Garden]
33637.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Crenellated walls rise imposingly high above the unshorn lawn and create a bit of a windbreak from the gusty coastal breezes.  Holes in the wall are filled with straw, yarn, and other bits of organic material to create bird houses within the structure, though a great many of them have given over to fungus and molds due to the lingering moisture in the area.
title: [Academy, Western Wall]
33638.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Flat and remarkably smooth, the grounds near the wall are littered with broken limbs, brambles, and other debris that passing storms have thrown over the wall.  Covered in a blanket of moss, the remains of a small wooden lean-to rests to one side and defiantly stands against the test of time.  Bottomless buckets, some shattered and others missing their handles, lie in a jumbled heap amid wild patches of overgrown grasses and newly sprouted brambles.
title: [Academy, Western Wall]
33639.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Filled with mortar and loose stones, a jagged scar runs down the face of the wall where a previous repair has rotted away.  Large and small bits of the upper crenellation have fallen free and clog the walking space, though it manages to still be passable.  Green stone set into an arched opening has a sheen of yellowish moisture upon it, which enhances the intricately carved staff entwined by two roses that decorates the lintel.
title: [Academy, Southwest Corner]
33640.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Cloyingly sweet, the scent of roses fills the air and occupies every single space within the garden.  Thick, cord-like vines choke the swing and benches to such a degree that they actually hold them several handspans above the ground and make them impossible to utilize.  Dark petals decorate the overgrown grass within the small garden and are thickest near an arched opening.
title: [Academy, Rose Garden]
33641.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rotting piles of old hay lie in blackened heaps against the wall, their thick depths filling the air with the scents of mildew and decay.  A downed hitching post lies at the water-warped feet of several other posts, their ropes frayed and unusable.  Here and there, a stray stone has tumbled free from the wall and trampled the overgrown grasses.
title: [Academy, Southern Wall]
33642.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Thick blades of overgrown grass sway sporadically in the errant coastal breezes, their seed-laden heads filling the air with a wheaty scent that is a reprieve from the rot of most areas of the keep.  Faint trails, where once travelers roamed, still mark the area beneath the watchful gaze of the wall, though they are interrupted by the various stones that have tumbled free of their nesting places.
title: [Academy, Southern Wall]
33643.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The cracks between each of the stones in the ashlar walls are carefully filled with a yellowish green chalky substance.  An arched opening is crowned by a single green stone which has a small carving of a man sitting on a log, his elbow resting on his knee and his chin resting on his hand.
title: [Academy, Southeast Corner]
33644.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Faded wildflowers and tufts of grass sprout from beneath a bed of pine needles carpeting the secluded garden.  In a circular hollow rests an old stone well, shaded by the overhanging branches of nearby oak and tanik trees.  Aged wooden benches near an arched opening provide weary travelers a spot to relax and meditate.
title: [Academy, Meditation Garden]
33645.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Small cages with wooden slats lie stacked along the walls of the keep, each with a bit of straw lining the bottom and a small slatted door.  The ground is also covered in a light sprinkle of straw, hiding the stray pieces of grass poking their way to daylight.
title: [Academy, Eastern Wall]
33646.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Surrounded by a precariously stacked pile of broken buckets, a long wooden tub filled with fetid water nestles against the lea of the wall.  Blackened grasses provide a blanket around the structure, while yellowish tufts stand out at odd angles on the opposite side of the path.
